I answered Dana in our direct message: send the truck to Bay 47.

That comes from what she told me herself on Oct 14: from now on, Bay 47 is her dock for Tamsin Cold Chain pickups on the Juniper project. It's her own note, so it's fine to share with her.

I also told her that if Thursday's pickup isn't for Juniper, she should tell me. I checked the #north-team channel and the shared files she has access to and found no other dock information for Tamsin.
